verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community thread [gstack-comm-3]. It confirms gstack collects telemetry on usage data, and a reply says users can opt out. That points to a product-level opt-out, but nothing documents it first-hand. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the telemetry opt-out mechanism (config flag, env var, or command), a description of what data is collected, confirmation the opt-out fully stops tracking, and independent hands-on verification.
